summary: Two-phase audio emitter allocation with fallback. If a2 is 0, returns 0 immediately. If the flag field this+0xEC has bit 0x4 clear, allocates two 60-byte emitter objects via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and constructs them with AudioEmitterCreate, storing the handles in globals dword_8B8DBC and dword_8B8DC0; each is registered via UtilityFunction_2950(dword_8B8DF4, dword_8B8DF4, dword_8B8DF8, 262152) and torn down (EmptyStub_7470 + FreeWrapper_7bcf, handle zeroed) if registration reports failure. Then sub_55B6B0(a2) runs primary stream initialization; if it returns 0, bit 0x10800 is OR'd into this+0xEC and the function returns 0, keeping the fallback emitters. On primary success, each live fallback handle is released via sub_542E50 then freed (EmptyStub_7470 + FreeWrapper_7bcf) and zeroed, and the function returns -1.

local_names.v5: first handle copy used by the free path after failed registration
local_names.v6: second 60-byte allocation result, passed to AudioEmitterCreate
local_names.v7: second audio emitter handle, stored to dword_8B8DC0

operations.description: If a2 == 0, return 0 immediately without allocating or initializing.
If this+0xEC bit 0x4 is clear, enter the fallback allocation branch that creates both audio emitters.
First fallback: OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(60) allocates a 60-byte emitter object; result may be null.
AudioEmitterCreate(v3) constructs the first audio emitter when the allocation is non-null.
Store the first emitter handle into global dword_8B8DBC.
UtilityFunction_2950(v4, dword_8B8DF4, dword_8B8DF4, dword_8B8DF8, 262152) registers/configures the first emitter; a non-zero return selects the failure cleanup.
On registration failure: if dword_8B8DBC is non-null, call EmptyStub_7470 then FreeWrapper_7bcf on it, then zero dword_8B8DBC.
Second fallback: OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(60) allocates another 60-byte emitter object; result may be null.
AudioEmitterCreate(v6) constructs the second audio emitter when the allocation is non-null.
Store the second emitter handle into global dword_8B8DC0.
UtilityFunction_2950(v7, dword_8B8DF4, dword_8B8DF4, dword_8B8DF8, 262152) registers/configures the second emitter; a non-zero return selects the failure cleanup.
On registration failure: if dword_8B8DC0 is non-null, call EmptyStub_7470 then FreeWrapper_7bcf on it, then zero dword_8B8DC0.
sub_55B6B0(a2) attempts primary stream initialization; a zero return selects the fallback retention path.
If primary init returns 0: OR bit 0x10800 into this+0xEC and return 0, leaving both fallback emitters allocated.
On primary success, if dword_8B8DBC is non-null: release it via sub_542E50, then EmptyStub_7470 + FreeWrapper_7bcf, then zero dword_8B8DBC.
On primary success, if dword_8B8DC0 is non-null: release it via sub_542E50, then EmptyStub_7470 + FreeWrapper_7bcf, then zero dword_8B8DC0.
Returns 0 when a2 is 0 or when primary init fails; returns -1 on the primary-success path.
